plan.subject: Marketing science

queries.query: ("charm pricing" OR "left-digit effect" OR ".99 pricing" OR "odd pricing") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR pricing OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Catches empirical studies on the effectiveness of odd-ending prices and left-digit bias in online and offline retail contexts.

queries.query: ("scarcity cue" OR "limited quantity" OR "limited time offer" OR "stock scarcity") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR "online retail")
queries.rationale: Targets experimental evidence on how scarcity messages (time, quantity) impact purchase decisions and conversion rates.

queries.query: ("social proof" OR "review valence" OR "review helpfulness" OR "star rating") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR "online retail")
queries.rationale: Finds studies quantifying the impact of customer reviews, ratings, and social proof signals on sales and trust.

queries.query: ("discount depth" OR "discount framing" OR "percent-off" OR "dollar-off") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR pricing)
queries.rationale: Captures research on how the size, presentation, and framing of discounts influence perceived value and brand perception.

queries.query: ("product naming" OR "brand name" OR "product description") AND (marketing OR consumer OR "consumer behavior")
queries.rationale: Targets experimental work on how specific words, sounds, and descriptions in product names affect consumer choice and recall.

queries.query: ("ad creative" OR "advertisement effectiveness" OR "visual attention") AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising)
queries.rationale: Finds studies using eye-tracking or A/B testing to identify visual and textual elements in ads that drive clicks and conversions.

queries.query: ("landing page" OR "conversion rate optimization" OR "checkout flow") AND (marketing OR ecommerce OR "online retail")
queries.rationale: Captures field experiments and usability studies on page layout, form fields, button design, and flow simplification that boost conversion.

queries.query: ("default option" OR "choice architecture" OR nudging) AND (marketing OR consumer OR "behavioral economics")
queries.rationale: Targets applied behavioral science research on how preset defaults and option structuring influence consumer decisions in online settings.

queries.query: ("free shipping" OR "shipping fee" OR "minimum purchase") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Finds empirical analyses of how shipping promotions, thresholds, and fee structures impact basket size and abandonment.

queries.query: ("price promotion" OR "sales promotion" OR "coupon redemption") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail)
queries.rationale: Captures research on the sales lift, profitability, and long-term customer effects of different promotional mechanics.

queries.query: ("personalization" OR "recommendation system" OR "targeted advertising") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Targets studies measuring the incremental conversion impact of personalized product recommendations, emails, and ads.

queries.query: ("A/B testing" OR "field experiment" OR "randomized controlled trial") AND (marketing OR ecommerce OR "online retail")
queries.rationale: Catches methodological papers and large-scale field experiments that establish causal evidence for marketing tactics, serving as a broad net for applied findings.

queries.query: ("visual complexity" OR "information overload" OR "decision fatigue") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Finds research on how the amount and presentation of information (options, details, images) on product pages affects choice quality and dropout.

queries.query: ("return policy" OR "money-back guarantee" OR "warranty") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Targets studies quantifying how generous return policies, guarantees, and warranties influence initial purchase likelihood and trust.

queries.query: ("subscription model" OR "free trial" OR "commitment") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Captures experimental evidence on the effectiveness of free trials, opt-out vs. opt-in defaults, and pricing structures for subscription services.

plan.coverage_notes: Plan focuses on empirical, conversion-relevant angles for a DTC practitioner: pricing psychology, scarcity, social proof, discounts, naming, ad/landing page optimization, choice architecture, and key e-commerce levers (shipping, personalization, subscriptions). Deliberately skips brand equity, advertising theory, media planning, and historical/cultural analysis. Includes a broad recall-safety query on marketing field experiments (id:12) to ensure sufficient corpus coverage.
